"""​分段​读取​与​确认​后​的​原子​文本​修改​，​避免​覆盖​读取​之后​的​外部​变更​。"""
import difflib
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import tempfile
from .tools import ToolInputError, Tool, ToolContext, ToolResult, object_schema
from .workspace import inside, instructions, instruction_fingerprint

LIMIT = 64 * 1024
FILE_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024


def resolve_file(context: ToolContext, name: str) -> Path:
    try:
        path = inside(context.root, name)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ToolInputError(str(exc)) from exc
    if path.exists() and not path.is_file():
        raise ToolInputError('​目标​不是​普通​文件​')
    return path


def read_bytes(path: Path) -> bytes:
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        data = stream.read(FILE_LIMIT + 1)
    if len(data) > FILE_LIMIT:
        raise ToolInputError('​文件​超过​ 1 MiB ​教学​实现​上限​')
    return data


def fingerprint(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def read_file(args: dict, context: ToolContext) -> ToolResult:
    path = resolve_file(context, args['path'])
    data = read_bytes(path)
    lines = data.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True)
    start, end = args.get('start_line', 1), args.get('end_line', max(1, len(lines)))
    if start < 1 or end < start or (start > len(lines) and lines):
        raise ToolInputError('​行号​从​ 1 ​开始​，​结束​行​不能​早​于​开始​行​或​超出​有效​起点​')
    selected = ''.join(lines[start - 1:end])
    if len(selected.encode('utf-8')) > LIMIT:
        raise ToolInputError('​返回​内容​超过​ 64 KiB，​请​用​ start_line/end_line ​缩小​范围​')
    rules = instructions(context.root, path)
    context.read_versions[str(path)] = (fingerprint(data), instruction_fingerprint(rules))
    context.rule_versions[str(path)] = instruction_fingerprint(rules)
    return ToolResult(True, {'content': selected, 'start_line': start, 'end_line': min(end, len(lines)),
                             'total_lines': len(lines), 'sha256': fingerprint(data), 'instructions': rules})


def checked_before(path: Path, context: ToolContext):
    if path.relative_to(context.root.resolve()).parts[0] in {'.fast-agent', '.git'}:
        raise ToolInputError('​禁止​用​文件​编辑​工具​修改​ Agent ​运行​记录​或​ Git ​内部​数据​')
    try:
        rules = instructions(context.root, path)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ToolInputError(str(exc)) from exc
    rule_hash = instruction_fingerprint(rules)
    if path.exists():
        before = read_bytes(path)
        if str(path) not in context.read_versions:
            raise ToolInputError('​修改​已有​文件​前​必须​先​调用​ read_file')
        if context.read_versions[str(path)] != (fingerprint(before), rule_hash):
            raise ToolInputError('​文件​或​ AGENTS.md ​已​发生变化​，​请​重新​读取​后​再​修改​')
    else:
        before = None
        if rules and context.rule_versions.get(str(path)) != rule_hash:
            raise ToolInputError('​创建​文件​前​必须​调用​ read_instructions ​查看​适用​规则​')
    return before, rules


def commit_text(path: Path, before: bytes | None, content: str, rules: list[dict], context: ToolContext, *, record_edit: bool = True, batch_approved: bool = False) -> ToolResult:
    data = content.encode('utf-8')
    if len(data) > FILE_LIMIT:
        raise ToolInputError('​内容​超过​ 1 MiB ​写入​上限​')
    old = before.decode('utf-8') if before is not None else ''
    chunks = difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True), content.splitlines(keepends=True),
                                  fromfile=str(path), tofile=str(path))
    diff = ''.join(chunk if chunk.endswith('\n') else chunk + '\n\\ No newline at end of file\n' for chunk in chunks)
    if before == data:
        return ToolResult(True, {'path': str(path.relative_to(context.root.resolve())), 'changed': False})
    if len(diff.encode('utf-8')) > LIMIT:
        raise ToolInputError('​修改​差异​超过​ 64 KiB，​请​拆​分为​更​小​的​修改​')
    preview = f'​修改​文件​ {path}\n{diff}\n​确认​写入​？'
    preview = ''.join(char if char in '\n\t' or (ord(char) >= 32 and ord(char) != 127) else f'\\x{ord(char):02x}' for char in preview)
    if not batch_approved and not context.authorize('write', str(path), preview):
        return ToolResult(False, error='​用户​未​批准​文件​修改​')
    def unchanged():
        current = read_bytes(path) if path.exists() else None
        if current != before or instructions(context.root, path) != rules:
            raise ToolInputError('​确认​期间​文件​或​ AGENTS.md ​发生变化​，​请​重新​读取​')
    unchanged()
    from .edit_history import EditHistory
    history = EditHistory(context.root)
    record = history.prepare(path, before, data) if record_edit else None
    temporary = None
    try:
        mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) if path.exists() else 0o600
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, prefix='.fast-agent-edit-', delete=False) as stream:
            temporary = Path(stream.name)
            os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), mode)
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        unchanged()
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if temporary is not None:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    if record is not None:
        history.finish(record, 'completed')
    context.read_versions[str(path)] = (fingerprint(data), instruction_fingerprint(rules))
    return ToolResult(True, {'path': str(path.relative_to(context.root.resolve())), 'changed': True, 'sha256': fingerprint(data), **({'edit_id': record['id']} if record else {})})


def write_file(args: dict, context: ToolContext) -> ToolResult:
    path = resolve_file(context, args['path'])
    before, rules = checked_before(path, context)
    return commit_text(path, before, args['content'], rules, context)


def unique_match(text: str, old: str) -> bool:
    """​从​下​一​字符​继续​搜索​，​避免​漏掉​重叠​的​第二个​匹配​。"""
    first = text.find(old)
    return bool(old) and first >= 0 and text.find(old, first + 1) < 0


def edit_file(args: dict, context: ToolContext) -> ToolResult:
    path = resolve_file(context, args['path'])
    before, rules = checked_before(path, context)
    if before is None:
        raise ToolInputError('​待​编辑​文件​不​存在​')
    text = before.decode('utf-8')
    old = args['old']
    if not unique_match(text, old):
        raise ToolInputError('​待​替换​文本​必须​非空且​唯一​匹配​')
    return commit_text(path, before, text.replace(old, args['new'], 1), rules, context)


def multi_edit_file(args: dict, context: ToolContext) -> ToolResult:
    """​全部​替换​先​在​内存​预演​，​再​复用​单​文件​确认​和​原子​提交​。"""
    edits = args['edits']
    if not 1 <= len(edits) <= 100:
        raise ToolInputError('​批量​替换​数量​必须​为​ 1 ​到​ 100')
    path = resolve_file(context, args['path'])
    before, rules = checked_before(path, context)
    if before is None:
        raise ToolInputError('​待​编辑​文件​不​存在​')
    text = before.decode('utf-8')
    for index, edit in enumerate(edits, 1):
        old = edit['old']
        if not unique_match(text, old):
            raise ToolInputError(f'​第​ {index} ​处待​替换​文本​必须​非空且​唯一​匹配​；​本​批次​未​写入​')
        text = text.replace(old, edit['new'], 1)
        if len(text.encode('utf-8')) > FILE_LIMIT:
            raise ToolInputError(f'​第​ {index} ​处​替换​后​内容​超过​ 1 MiB；​本​批次​未​写入​')
    return commit_text(path, before, text, rules, context)


def file_tools() -> list[Tool]:
    string = {'type': 'string'}
    edits_schema = {'type': 'array', 'minItems': 1, 'maxItems': 100,
                    'items': object_schema({'old': string, 'new': string}, ['old', 'new'])}
    return [
        Tool('multi_edit_file', '​先​ read_file，​再​按​ edits ​顺序​在​内存​精确​替换​，​每个​ old ​须​在​当时​文本​中非​空且​唯一​匹配​；1 ​到​ 100 ​处​，​全部​成功​才​确认​整体​差异​并​原子​写入​单个​文件​，​任一​失败​均​不​写入​', object_schema({'path': string, 'edits': edits_schema}, ['path', 'edits']), multi_edit_file),
        Tool('read_file', '​读取​ UTF-8 ​文件​，​最大​ 1 MiB；​支持​从​ 1 ​开始​的​ start_line/end_line（​含​结束​行​），​返回​最​多​ 64 KiB，​附带​沿途​ AGENTS.md', object_schema({'path': string, 'start_line': {'type': 'integer'}, 'end_line': {'type': 'integer'}}, ['path']), read_file, 'read'),
        Tool('write_file', '​创建​或​覆盖​文本​，​展示​差异​并​确认​；​已有​文件​必须​先​ read_file，​新​文件​先​ read_instructions；​父​目录​必须​存在​', object_schema({'path': string, 'content': string}, ['path', 'content']), write_file),
        Tool('edit_file', '​先​读取​文件​后​精确​替换​唯一​的​ old；​展示​差异​并​确认​，​检测​并​拒绝​外部​修改​', object_schema({'path': string, 'old': string, 'new': string}, ['path', 'old', 'new']), edit_file),
    ]

"""​独立​执行器​：​终端​退出​后​继续​运行​；​取消​/​超时​清理​整个​进程​组​。"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import selectors
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from .runtime_store import RuntimeStore
from .command_sandbox import command_launch

LOG_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024


def run(root, job):
    store = RuntimeStore(Path(root), 'jobs')
    with store.lock(job + '.lock'):
        state = store.read(job + '.json')
        if state['status'] != 'queued':
            return  # ​永远​不​重启​已经​运行​过​的​命令​
        if store.path(job + '.cancel').exists():
            state.update(status='cancelled', updated=time.time())
            store.write(job + '.json', state)
            return
        process = None
        try:
            state.update(status='running', updated=time.time())
            store.write(job + '.json', state)
            launch, env = command_launch(state['argv'], root, state.get('sandbox', 'none'))
            process = subprocess.Popen(launch, cwd=root, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True, env=env)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + state['timeout']
            last_heartbeat = 0
            size = 0
            fd = os.open(store.path(job + '.log'), os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
            with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb', buffering=0) as log, selectors.DefaultSelector() as selector:
                selector.register(process.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ)
                while selector.get_map() or process.poll() is None:
                    if store.path(job + '.cancel').exists():
                        state['status'] = 'cancelled'
                        break
                    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                        state['status'] = 'timed_out'
                        break
                    if time.monotonic() - last_heartbeat >= .5:
                        state['updated'] = time.time()
                        store.write(job + '.json', state)
                        last_heartbeat = time.monotonic()
                    for key, _ in selector.select(.05):
                        chunk = os.read(key.fileobj.fileno(), 8192)
                        if not chunk:
                            selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
                            continue
                        kept = chunk[:max(0, LOG_LIMIT-size)]
                        log.write(kept)
                        size += len(kept)
                        state['truncated'] |= len(kept) < len(chunk)
                if state['status'] == 'running':
                    state['status'] = 'succeeded' if process.poll() == 0 else 'failed'
        except Exception:
            state.update(status='unknown' if process else 'failed', error='​后台​执行器​异常​，​请​检查​日志​；​不要​自动​重​放​')
        finally:
            if process:
                try:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                process.wait()
                process.stdout.close()
                state['returncode'] = process.returncode
            state['updated'] = time.time()
            store.write(job + '.json', state)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

"""​后台​命令​的​持久​化​句柄​、​有限​日志​和​协作​取消​。"""
import math
import os
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
from .runtime_store import RuntimeStore
from .tools import ToolInputError, Tool, ToolResult, object_schema

ACTIVE = {'queued', 'running'}


class JobStore:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.store = RuntimeStore(root, 'jobs')

    def start(self, argv, timeout=300, sandbox="none"):
        if not isinstance(argv, list) or not argv or any(not isinstance(a, str) or '\0' in a for a in argv) or not argv[0]:
            raise ToolInputError('​命令​必须​是​有效​的​非空​ argv ​数组​')
        if not math.isfinite(timeout) or not 0 < timeout <= 3600:
            raise ToolInputError('​后台​超时​必须​大于​ 0 ​且​不​超过​ 3600 ​秒​')
        from .command_sandbox import command_launch
        command_launch(argv, self.store.root, sandbox)  # ​创建​任务​前​检查​支持​情况​
        job = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.store.write(job + '.json', {'id': job, 'workspace': str(self.store.root), 'argv': argv,
            'sandbox': sandbox, 'timeout': timeout, 'status': 'queued', 'updated': time.time(), 'truncated': False, 'returncode': None})
        # ​不​把​模型​凭据​传给​命令​进程​；​不​在​日志​/​记录​中​复制​环境变量​。
        env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k != 'FAST_AGENT_API_KEY'}
        try:
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-m', 'fast_agent.job_worker', str(self.store.root), job],
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                start_new_session=True, env=env)
        except OSError:
            state = self.store.read(job + '.json')
            state.update(status='failed', error='​无法​启动​后台​执行器​')
            self.store.write(job + '.json', state)
            raise
        return job

    def poll(self, job, offset=0):
        if type(offset) is not int or offset < 0:
            raise ToolInputError('​日志​偏移​必须​为​非负​整数​（​字节​）')
        state = self.store.read(job + '.json')
        if state.get('workspace') != str(self.store.root) or state.get('id') != job:
            raise ToolInputError('​后台任务​工作​目录​或​ ID ​不​一致​')
        if state['status'] in ACTIVE and time.time() - state['updated'] > 10:
            state['status'] = 'unknown'
            state['error'] = '​执行器​心跳​丢失​；​结果​未知​，​不能​据此​重启​命令​'
        path = self.store.path(job + '.log')
        output = b''
        if path.exists():
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                stream.seek(offset)
                output = stream.read(65536)
        state.update(output=output.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), next_offset=offset + len(output))
        return state

    def list(self):
        return [{'id': n, 'status': self.poll(n)['status']} for n in self.store.names() if len(n) == 32]

    def blockers(self):
        return ['job:' + j['id'] for j in self.list()
                if j['status'] == 'unknown' and not self.store.path(j['id'] + '.resolved').exists()]

    def resolve(self, job, note):
        if not note.strip() or len(note) > 4000:
            raise ToolInputError('​请​提供​ 1～4000 ​字符​的​人工​核实​说明​')
        if self.poll(job)['status'] != 'unknown':
            raise ToolInputError('​仅​结果​未知​的​后台任务​需要​人工​解除​阻止​')
        self.store.write(job + '.resolved', {'note': note, 'updated': time.time()})

    def cancel(self, job):
        state = self.poll(job)
        if state['status'] in ACTIVE | {'unknown'}:
            self.store.write(job + '.cancel', {'requested': time.time()})
        return state


def start_command(args, context):
    argv = args['argv']
    if not context.authorize('command', argv, f'​启动​后台​命令​ {shlex.join(argv)}？'):
        return ToolResult(False, error='​后台​命令​未获​批准​')
    job = JobStore(context.root).start(argv, args.get('timeout', 300), context.sandbox)
    return ToolResult(True, {'job_id': job, 'status': 'queued'})


def poll_command(args, context):
    wait = args.get('wait_seconds', 0)
    if not math.isfinite(wait) or not 0 <= wait <= 10:
        raise ToolInputError('​等待时间​必须​在​ 0～10 ​秒​之间​')
    jobs = JobStore(context.root)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + wait
    while True:
        state = jobs.poll(args['job_id'], args.get('offset', 0))
        if state['status'] not in ACTIVE or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            return ToolResult(True, state)
        time.sleep(min(.1, max(0, deadline-time.monotonic())))


def cancel_command(args, context):
    if not context.authorize('cancel', args['job_id'], f"​取消​后台任务​ {args['job_id']}？"):
        return ToolResult(False, error='​取消​任务​未获​批准​')
    state = JobStore(context.root).cancel(args['job_id'])
    return ToolResult(True, {'job_id': args['job_id'], 'status': state['status'], 'cancel_requested': True})


def job_tools():
    string = {'type': 'string'}
    return [
        Tool('start_command', '​后台​启动​经​批准​的​ argv ​命令​；​返回​ job_id，​必须​ poll_command ​核实​退出​码​；​超时​默认​ 300 ​秒​，​最大​ 3600', object_schema({'argv': {'type':'array','items':string}, 'timeout': {'type':'number'}}, ['argv']), start_command),
        Tool('poll_command', '​查询​后台​状态​和​最​多​ 64 KiB ​日志​；offset ​是​字节​偏移​，wait_seconds ​最​多​ 10 ​秒​；​成功​启动​不​代表​命令​成功​', object_schema({'job_id':string,'offset':{'type':'integer'},'wait_seconds':{'type':'number'}}, ['job_id']), poll_command, 'read'),
        Tool('cancel_command', '​经​确认​请求​取消​后台任务​；​之后​ poll_command ​核实​ cancelled ​状态​', object_schema({'job_id':string}, ['job_id']), cancel_command),
    ]

"""​显式​配置​、​逐次​批准​的​ LSP ​查询​；​每次​查询​独立​启动​并​关闭​语言​服务​。"""
import json
import math
import re
from .command_sandbox import command_launch
from .file_tools import resolve_file,read_bytes,fingerprint
from .lsp_transport import LSPClient
from .tools import Tool,ToolResult,ToolInputError,object_schema


def lsp_tools(config):
    if config is None:return []
    with config.open('rb') as stream:raw=stream.read(65537)
    if len(raw)>65536:raise ValueError('LSP ​配置​超过​ 64 KiB')
    spec=json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(spec,dict) or set(spec)-{'argv','language_id','extensions','timeout'}:
        raise ValueError('LSP ​配置​字​段​无效​')
    argv=spec.get('argv');language=spec.get('language_id');extensions=spec.get('extensions')
    timeout=spec.get('timeout',10)
    if not isinstance(argv,list) or not 1<=len(argv)<=64 or any(not isinstance(s,str) or not s or len(s)>4000 or '\0' in s for s in argv):
        raise ValueError('LSP argv ​无效​')
    if not isinstance(language,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,40}',language):
        raise ValueError('LSP language_id ​无效​')
    if not isinstance(extensions,list) or not 1<=len(extensions)<=20 or any(not isinstance(s,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,16}',s) for s in extensions):
        raise ValueError('LSP extensions ​无效​')
    if type(timeout) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(timeout) or not 0<timeout<=60:
        raise ValueError('LSP timeout ​必须​在​ 0～60 ​秒​之间​')

    def handler(kind):
        def run(args,context):
            path=resolve_file(context,args['path'])
            if path.suffix not in extensions:raise ToolInputError('​文件​扩展名​不​在​ LSP ​配置​范围​')
            before=read_bytes(path);text=before.decode('utf-8')
            position=None
            if kind=='definition':
                lines=text.splitlines();line=args['line'];column=args['column']
                if not 1<=line<=len(lines) or not 1<=column<=len(lines[line-1])+1:
                    raise ToolInputError('​行列​从​ 1 ​开始​，​必须​位于​文件​内​')
                position={'line':line-1,'character':len(lines[line-1][:column-1].encode('utf-16-le'))//2}
            from .tasks import TaskStore
            if TaskStore(context.root).blockers():raise ToolInputError('​存在​未​核实​操作​，​不能​启动​ LSP')
            target={'argv':argv,'path':str(path),'operation':kind}
            if not context.authorize('lsp_start',target,'​启动​语言​服务​（​可​读取​项目​文件​，​沿用​命令​沙箱​） '+json.dumps(target,ensure_ascii=False)+'？'):
                raise ToolInputError('LSP ​启动​未获​授权​')
            if read_bytes(path)!=before:raise ToolInputError('​确认​期间​文件​发生变化​')
            launch,env=command_launch(argv,context.root,context.sandbox)
            client=LSPClient(launch,env,context.root.resolve(),timeout)
            try:
                capabilities=client.initialize()
                capability={'symbols':'documentSymbolProvider','definition':'definitionProvider'}.get(kind)
                if capability and capabilities.get(capability) in (None,False):
                    raise ValueError('​语言​服务​未声明​该​查询​能力​')
                uri=path.as_uri()
                client.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'textDocument/didOpen','params':{
                    'textDocument':{'uri':uri,'languageId':language,'version':1,'text':text}}})
                if kind=='diagnostics':result=client.wait_diagnostics(uri,1)
                else:
                    params={'textDocument':{'uri':uri}}
                    if position is not None:params['position']=position
                    result=client.request('textDocument/'+('documentSymbol' if kind=='symbols' else 'definition'),params)
                if read_bytes(path)!=before:raise ValueError('​分析​期间​文件​发生变化​，​请​重新​查询​')
                return ToolResult(True,{'path':args['path'],'sha256':fingerprint(before),'position_encoding':'utf-16',
                    'result':result,'result_trusted':False})
            except (ValueError,OSError):
                return ToolResult(False,error='LSP ​查询​失败​、​超时​或​文件​变化​；​未​确认​取得​当前​结果​')
            finally:client.shutdown()
        return run
    properties={'path':{'type':'string'}}
    return [
        Tool('lsp_symbols','​查询​当前​文件​符号​；​需​批准​启动​语言​服务​',object_schema(properties,['path']),handler('symbols')),
        Tool('lsp_definition','​查询​定义​；​输入​行列​从​1​开始​，​列​按​Unicode​字符​计数​；​结果​位置​为​LSP​零基​UTF-16',object_schema({**properties,'line':{'type':'integer'},'column':{'type':'integer'}},['path','line','column']),handler('definition')),
        Tool('lsp_diagnostics','​等待​当前​文件​版本​诊断​；​超时​不​表示​没有​错误​',object_schema(properties,['path']),handler('diagnostics'))]

"""LSP Content-Length ​帧​；​复用​进程​管道​/​进程​组​清理​，​不​复用​ MCP ​协议​。"""
import json,os,selectors,time,subprocess
from .mcp_transport import StdioClient,decode

LIMIT=1024*1024


class LSPClient(StdioClient):
    def __init__(self,argv,env,root,timeout=10):
        super().__init__(argv,env,root,timeout)
        self.root=root;self.diagnostics={};self.received_bytes=0

    def send(self,message,deadline=None):
        body=json.dumps(message,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode()
        if len(body)>LIMIT:raise ValueError('LSP ​请求​超限​')
        raw=f'Content-Length: {len(body)}\r\n\r\n'.encode()+body
        deadline=deadline or time.monotonic()+self.timeout
        with selectors.DefaultSelector() as writable:
            writable.register(self.process.stdin,selectors.EVENT_WRITE)
            while raw:
                if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise ValueError('LSP ​写入​超时​')
                if not writable.select(max(0,deadline-time.monotonic())):raise ValueError('LSP ​写入​超时​')
                raw=raw[os.write(self.process.stdin.fileno(),raw):]

    def receive(self,deadline):
        while True:
            if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise ValueError('LSP ​响应​超时​')
            boundary=self.buffer.find(b'\r\n\r\n')
            if boundary>=0:
                if boundary>8192:raise ValueError('LSP ​头部​超限​')
                lengths=[]
                for line in self.buffer[:boundary].split(b'\r\n'):
                    key,sep,value=line.partition(b':')
                    if not sep:raise ValueError('LSP ​帧​头​无效​')
                    if key.lower()==b'content-length':lengths.append(value.strip())
                if len(lengths)!=1 or not lengths[0].isdigit():raise ValueError('LSP ​长度​无效​')
                size=int(lengths[0])
                if size>LIMIT:raise ValueError('LSP ​帧​超限​')
                end=boundary+4+size
                if len(self.buffer)>=end:
                    body=self.buffer[boundary+4:end];self.buffer=self.buffer[end:]
                    value=decode(body)
                    if not isinstance(value,dict) or value.get('jsonrpc')!='2.0':raise ValueError('LSP JSON-RPC ​无效​')
                    return value
            elif len(self.buffer)>8192:raise ValueError('LSP ​帧​头​超限​')
            remaining=deadline-time.monotonic()
            if remaining<=0:raise ValueError('LSP ​响应​超时​')
            ready=self.selector.select(remaining)
            if not ready:raise ValueError('LSP ​响应​超时​')
            for key,_ in ready:
                chunk=os.read(key.fd,8192)
                if not chunk:
                    self.selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
                    if key.fileobj is self.process.stdout:raise ValueError('LSP ​服务​断开​')
                    continue
                self.received_bytes+=len(chunk)
                if self.received_bytes>2*LIMIT:raise ValueError('LSP ​输出​流​超限​')
                if key.fileobj is self.process.stdout:self.buffer+=chunk

    def notice(self,message,deadline):
        if 'id' in message:
            self.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':message['id'],'error':{'code':-32601,'message':'Client capability not supported'}},deadline)
        elif message.get('method')=='textDocument/publishDiagnostics':
            params=message.get('params',{})
            if not isinstance(params,dict):raise ValueError('LSP ​诊断​参数​无效​')
            uri=params.get('uri');items=params.get('diagnostics')
            if isinstance(uri,str) and isinstance(items,list):
                if uri not in self.diagnostics and len(self.diagnostics)>=32:raise ValueError('LSP ​诊断​文档​数量​超限​')
                self.diagnostics[uri]={'version':params.get('version'),'items':items[:200],'truncated':len(items)>200}

    def request(self,method,params):
        if self.closed:raise ValueError('LSP ​已​关闭​')
        self.received_bytes=len(self.buffer)
        self.sequence+=1;identifier=self.sequence;deadline=time.monotonic()+self.timeout
        try:
            self.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':identifier,'method':method,'params':params},deadline)
            for _ in range(100):
                message=self.receive(deadline)
                if 'method' in message:self.notice(message,deadline);continue
                if type(message.get('id')) is not int or message['id']!=identifier or 'error' in message or 'result' not in message:
                    raise ValueError('LSP ​响应​不​匹配​或​请求​失败​')
                return message['result']
            raise ValueError('LSP ​消息​数量​超限​')
        except BaseException:self.close();raise

    def wait_diagnostics(self,uri,version):
        """​只​返回​指定​版本​；​旧版本​/​无​版本​通知​不能​冒充​当前​文件​诊断​。"""
        if self.closed:raise ValueError('LSP ​已​关闭​')
        deadline=time.monotonic()+self.timeout
        self.received_bytes=len(self.buffer)
        try:
            for _ in range(100):
                result=self.diagnostics.get(uri)
                if result is not None and type(result.get('version')) is int and result['version']==version:
                    return result
                message=self.receive(deadline)
                if 'method' not in message:raise ValueError('LSP ​未​预期​响应​')
                self.notice(message,deadline)
            raise ValueError('LSP ​消息​数量​超限​')
        except BaseException:self.close();raise

    def initialize(self):
        result=self.request('initialize',{'processId':os.getpid(),'rootUri':self.root.as_uri(),
            'capabilities':{'general':{'positionEncodings':['utf-16']},'textDocument':{'publishDiagnostics':{'versionSupport':True}}}})
        if not isinstance(result,dict) or not isinstance(result.get('capabilities'),dict):
            self.close();raise ValueError('LSP ​初始化​能力​无效​')
        if result['capabilities'].get('positionEncoding','utf-16')!='utf-16':
            self.close();raise ValueError('LSP ​暂只​支持​ UTF-16 ​位置​编码​')
        self.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'initialized','params':{}})
        return result['capabilities']

    def shutdown(self):
        """​尽力​协议​关闭​；​短​截止​时间​后​仍​清理​进程​组​，​不​无限​等待​服务​退出​。"""
        if self.closed:return False
        previous_timeout=self.timeout
        self.timeout=min(previous_timeout,.5)
        try:
            if self.request('shutdown',None) is not None:return False
            self.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'exit'})
            self.process.wait(timeout=.5)
            return self.process.returncode==0
        except (ValueError,OSError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            return False
        finally:
            self.timeout=previous_timeout
            self.close()

"""MCP 2025 Streamable HTTP ​子集​：​有​界​ POST JSON/SSE，​不​自动​重​放​。"""
import asyncio
import ipaddress
import json
import re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import httpx2
from .mcp_transport import decode, MAX_FRAME

class MCPHTTPError(ValueError):
    """​仅​携带​本地​生成​的​安全​提示​，​不​包含​服务​响应​或​凭据​。"""


HTTP_VERSIONS = {'2025-11-25', '2025-06-18'}


def loopback(host):
    if host == 'localhost':
        return True
    try:
        return ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_loopback
    except ValueError:
        return False


def validate_url(url, allow_insecure=False):
    if (not isinstance(url, str) or len(url)>2048 or type(allow_insecure) is not bool
            or any(ord(c)<=32 or ord(c)>=127 for c in url) or '\\' in url):
        raise MCPHTTPError('MCP URL ​无效​')
    try:
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        port = parts.port
        if (parts.scheme not in {'https','http'} or not parts.hostname or parts.username is not None
                or parts.password is not None or parts.query or parts.fragment or port == 0):
            raise MCPHTTPError()
    except ValueError:
        raise MCPHTTPError('MCP URL ​必须​是​无​凭据​、​查询​或​片段​的​ HTTP(S) ​地址​') from None
    if parts.scheme == 'http' and not loopback(parts.hostname) and not allow_insecure:
        raise MCPHTTPError('​远程​ MCP ​默认​要求​ HTTPS；​明文​地址​须​显式​ allow_insecure_http=true')
    return parts


class SSEMessages:
    """​按​字节​增量​分行​；UTF-8 ​可以​跨​网络​分块​，​不能​逐块​直接​ decode。"""
    def __init__(self):
        self.buffer = b''
        self.data = []
        self.size = 0
        self.events = 0
        self.skip_lf = False
        self.first_line = True

    def feed(self, chunk):
        self.buffer += chunk
        output = []
        while True:
            if self.skip_lf and self.buffer:
                if self.buffer.startswith(b'\n'):
                    self.buffer = self.buffer[1:]
                self.skip_lf = False
            positions = [p for p in (self.buffer.find(b'\n'), self.buffer.find(b'\r')) if p>=0]
            if not positions:
                break
            index = min(positions)
            self.skip_lf = self.buffer[index:index+1] == b'\r'
            separator = 1
            raw, self.buffer = self.buffer[:index], self.buffer[index+separator:]
            if len(raw)>MAX_FRAME:
                raise MCPHTTPError('MCP SSE ​行​超过​ 64 KiB')
            line = raw.decode('utf-8')
            if self.first_line:
                line = line.removeprefix('\ufeff')
                self.first_line = False
            if not line:
                self.events += 1
                if self.events>100:
                    raise MCPHTTPError('MCP SSE ​事件​超过​ 100 ​条​')
                if self.data:
                    text = '\n'.join(self.data)
                    if text.strip():
                        output.append(text)
                self.data, self.size = [], 0
            elif line.startswith('data:') or line == 'data':
                value = line[5:] if ':' in line else ''
                if value.startswith(' '):
                    value = value[1:]
                self.size += len(value.encode('utf-8'))+1
                if self.size>MAX_FRAME:
                    raise MCPHTTPError('MCP SSE ​消息​超过​ 64 KiB')
                self.data.append(value)
            # event/id/retry/comment ​不​作为​指令​执行​；​本​阶段​不​支持​事件​续传​。
        if len(self.buffer)>MAX_FRAME:
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP SSE ​行​超过​ 64 KiB')
        return output


class HttpClient:
    def __init__(self, url, timeout, token=None, allow_insecure=False, *, token_provider=None, tls_context=None):
        import ssl
        if tls_context is not None and (not isinstance(tls_context,ssl.SSLContext) or not tls_context.check_hostname or tls_context.verify_mode!=ssl.CERT_REQUIRED):
            raise MCPHTTPError("TLS ​上下文​必须​校验​证书及​主机名​")
        self.tls_context=tls_context if tls_context is not None else True
        parts = validate_url(url, allow_insecure)
        if token is not None and (not isinstance(token,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[\x21-\x7e]{1,4096}',token)):
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP Bearer ​凭据​无效​或​未​配置​')
        self.url = url
        self.timeout = timeout
        self._token = token
        self._token_provider = token_provider
        self._session = None
        self.version = None
        self.sequence = 0
        self.closed = False
        # ​回环​验证​和​本地​服务​不能​绕​到​外部​代理​。
        self.trust_env = not loopback(parts.hostname)

    @property
    def is_alive(self):
        return not self.closed

    def headers(self, refresh=True):
        if refresh and self._token_provider is not None:
            try:token=self._token_provider()
            except Exception:raise MCPHTTPError("OAuth ​凭据​不可​用​，​请​检查​授权​状态​或​重新​登录​") from None
            if not isinstance(token,str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[\x21-\x7e]{1,16384}",token):raise MCPHTTPError("OAuth ​令牌​格式​无效​")
            self._token=token
        headers = {'Accept':'application/json, text/event-stream', 'Content-Type':'application/json', 'Accept-Encoding':'identity'}
        if self._token:
            headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer '+self._token
        if self._session:
            headers['Mcp-Session-Id'] = self._session
        if self.version:
            headers['Mcp-Protocol-Version'] = self.version
        return headers

    async def exchange(self, http, message, expected_id=None, initializing=False):
        raw = json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')
        if len(raw)>MAX_FRAME:
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​请求​超过​ 64 KiB')
        async with http.stream('POST', self.url, content=raw, headers=self.headers(refresh=False)) as response:
            if response.status_code in (401,403):
                raise MCPHTTPError(f'MCP HTTP {response.status_code}：​认证​或​权限​失败​，​请​检查​独立​服务​凭据​')
            if response.status_code == 404:
                raise MCPHTTPError('MCP HTTP 404：​端点​或会话​不可​用​，​核实​后​显式​重新​连接​')
            if expected_id is None:
                if response.status_code != 202:
                    raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​通知​/​回复​未​被​接受​（​需要​ HTTP 202）')
                return None
            if response.status_code != 200:
                raise MCPHTTPError(f'MCP HTTP {response.status_code}：​请求​失败​，​不​跟随​重定向​或​自动​重试​')
            session = response.headers.get('mcp-session-id')
            if initializing and session is not None:
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[\x21-\x7e]{1,256}',session):
                    raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​会话​标识​无效​')
                self._session = session
            elif session is not None and session != self._session:
                raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​服务​在​响应​中​更换​会话​标识​')
            if response.headers.get('content-encoding','identity').lower() != 'identity':
                raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​不​支持​压缩​响应​')
            kind = response.headers.get('content-type','').split(';')[0].strip().lower()
            if kind not in {'application/json','text/event-stream'}:
                raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​响应​必须​为​ JSON ​或​ SSE')
            parser = SSEMessages()
            body = bytearray()
            total = 0
            async for chunk in response.aiter_raw():
                total += len(chunk)
                if total>1048576:
                    raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​响应​超过​ 1 MiB')
                if kind == 'application/json':
                    body.extend(chunk)
                    if len(body)>MAX_FRAME:
                        raise MCPHTTPError('MCP JSON ​消息​超过​ 64 KiB')
                    continue
                for text in parser.feed(chunk):
                    result = await self.message(http, decode(text), expected_id)
                    if result is not None:
                        return result
            if kind == 'application/json':
                result = await self.message(http, decode(bytes(body).decode('utf-8')), expected_id)
                if result is not None:
                    return result
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​响应​结束​但​未​收到​匹配​结果​；​不​自动​重​放​')

    async def message(self, http, message, expected_id):
        if not isinstance(message,dict) or message.get('jsonrpc') != '2.0':
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP JSON-RPC ​响应​无效​')
        if 'method' in message:
            if not isinstance(message['method'],str):
                raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​反向​请求​方法​无效​')
            if 'id' in message:
                if type(message['id']) not in (int,str):
                    raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​反向​请求​ id ​无效​')
                await self.exchange(http, {'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':message['id'],
                    'error':{'code':-32601,'message':'Client capability not supported'}})
            return None
        if type(message.get('id')) is not int or message['id'] != expected_id:
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​响应​ id ​不​匹配​')
        if ('result' in message) == ('error' in message) or 'error' in message:
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP ​服务​返回​协议​错误​')
        if not isinstance(message['result'],dict):
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP result ​必须​为​对象​')
        return message['result']

    async def perform(self, message, expected_id=None, initializing=False):
        # ​总​截止​时间​覆盖​ DNS/​连接​/headers/body/SSE/​反向​请求​，​不​被​心跳​重置​。
        async with asyncio.timeout(self.timeout):
            async with httpx2.AsyncClient(timeout=self.timeout, follow_redirects=False,
                                          trust_env=self.trust_env,verify=self.tls_context) as http:
                return await self.exchange(http,message,expected_id,initializing)

    def request(self, method, params):
        if self.closed:
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP HTTP ​连接​已​关闭​，​需​重新​授权​')
        self.sequence += 1
        try:
            # ​授权​交互​/​刷新​在​网络​事件​循环​外​进行​；MCP​截止​时间​只​覆盖​实际​MCP​请求​。
            self.headers()
            return asyncio.run(self.perform({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':self.sequence,'method':method,'params':params},
                                            self.sequence,method=='initialize'))
        except (httpx2.HTTPError, TimeoutError, ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
            self.close()
            if isinstance(exc, MCPHTTPError):
                raise
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP HTTP ​连接​、​响应​或​超时​异常​；​结果​需​核实​') from None
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def initialize(self):
        try:
            result = self.request('initialize',{'protocolVersion':'2025-11-25','capabilities':{},
                'clientInfo':{'name':'fast-agent','version':'0.1.0'}})
            version = result.get('protocolVersion')
            if (not isinstance(version,str) or version not in HTTP_VERSIONS
                    or not isinstance(result.get('capabilities'),dict)
                    or not isinstance(result['capabilities'].get('tools'),dict)):
                raise MCPHTTPError('MCP HTTP ​协议​版本​或​ tools ​能力​不​支持​')
            self.version = version
            asyncio.run(self.perform({'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'notifications/initialized'}))
        except (httpx2.HTTPError, TimeoutError, ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
            self.close()
            if isinstance(exc, MCPHTTPError):
                raise
            raise MCPHTTPError('MCP HTTP ​初始化​失败​，​请​检查​服务​连接​和​响应​') from None
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    async def terminate(self):
        async with asyncio.timeout(min(self.timeout,2)):
            async with httpx2.AsyncClient(timeout=min(self.timeout,2),follow_redirects=False,trust_env=self.trust_env,verify=self.tls_context) as http:
                async with http.stream('DELETE',self.url,headers=self.headers(refresh=False)):
                    pass  # 405 ​等​失败​不​重试​；​本地连接​始终​关闭​，​远端​可能​依赖​TTL​回收​。

    def close(self):
        if self.closed:
            return
        self.closed = True
        try:
            if self._session:
                asyncio.run(self.terminate())
        except Exception:
            pass
        finally:
            self._session = None
            self._token = None
            self._token_provider = None

"""MCP OAuth ​配置​与​本地​入口​，​配置文件​不​允许​携带​令牌​。"""
from pathlib import Path
from .oauth_flow import secure_endpoint
from .oauth_session import OAuthSession


def validate_oauth(spec):
    value=spec['oauth']
    if 'bearer_env' in spec or 'url' not in spec:raise ValueError('OAuth ​仅​用于​ HTTP ​且​不能​与​ bearer_env ​混用​')
    secure_endpoint(spec['url'])
    if not isinstance(value,dict) or set(value)-{'issuer','client_id','scope','port','directory'}:raise ValueError('OAuth ​配置​字​段​无效​')
    secure_endpoint(value.get('issuer'))
    client=value.get('client_id')
    if not isinstance(client,str) or not 1<=len(client)<=1024 or any(ord(c)<33 for c in client):raise ValueError('OAuth client_id ​无效​')
    scope=value.get('scope','')
    if not isinstance(scope,str) or len(scope)>2000 or any(ord(c)<32 or ord(c)>126 for c in scope):raise ValueError('OAuth scope ​无效​')
    port=value.get('port',0)
    if type(port) is not int or not 0<=port<=65535:raise ValueError('OAuth ​回调​端口​无效​')
    directory=value.get('directory')
    if directory is not None and (not isinstance(directory,str) or not Path(directory).is_absolute()):raise ValueError('OAuth directory ​需要​绝对路径​')


def make_session(spec,context):
    from .mcp_tls import tls_context
    value=spec['oauth']
    directory=value.get('directory',str(Path.home()/'.local/share/fast-agent/oauth'))
    return OAuthSession(context.root,directory,spec['url'],value['client_id'],
        lambda url:context.authorize('mcp_oauth',{'server':spec['name'],'url':url},'​允许​ OAuth ​操作​/​访问​ '+url+'？'),
        issuer=value['issuer'],scope=value.get('scope',''),port=value.get('port',0),tls_context=tls_context(spec) or True)


def action(manager,name,operation,show_url=print):
    specs=[s for s in manager.specs if s['name']==name and 'oauth' in s]
    if len(specs)!=1:raise ValueError('​没有​匹配​的​ OAuth ​服务​')
    session=make_session(specs[0],manager.context)
    try:
        if operation=='login':return session.login(show_url)
        if operation=='status':
            tokens=session.store.load(session.resource,session.issuer,session.client_id)
            return tokens.status() if tokens else {'authorized':False}
        if operation in {'logout','revoke'}:
            return session.logout(revoke=operation=='revoke')
        raise ValueError('OAuth ​操作​无效​')
    finally:session.close()

"""​显式​附加​ CA；​保留​系统​根​证书​、​证书​校验​与​主机名​校验​。"""
import os
import ssl
import stat


CA_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024


def tls_context(spec):
    if 'ca_file' not in spec:
        return None
    # NOFOLLOW​拒绝​末级​链接​；NONBLOCK​避免​替换成​FIFO​后​阻塞​在​open。
    try:
        fd = os.open(spec['ca_file'], os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ValueError('MCP CA ​文件​必须​是​最​多​1MiB​的​普通​文件​') from exc
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb') as stream:
        metadata = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode) or metadata.st_size > CA_LIMIT:
            raise ValueError('MCP CA ​文件​必须​是​最​多​1MiB​的​普通​文件​')
        data = stream.read(CA_LIMIT + 1)
        if len(data) > CA_LIMIT:
            raise ValueError('MCP CA ​文件​必须​是​最​多​1MiB​的​普通​文件​')
    context = ssl.create_default_context()
    context.load_verify_locations(cadata=data.decode('ascii'))
    return context

"""​显式​ MCP ​配置​、​工具​发现​和​逐次​授权​；​不​信任​服务​自报​的​只读​标注​。"""
import copy
import json
import math
import os
import re
import ssl
from pathlib import Path
from .command_sandbox import command_launch
from .extensions import schema_checked
from .mcp_transport import StdioClient, decode
from .tools import Tool, ToolResult, ToolInputError


def load_servers(path):
    if path is None:
        return []
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        raw = stream.read(65537)
    if len(raw) > 65536:
        raise ValueError('MCP ​配置​超过​ 64 KiB')
    value = decode(raw)
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {'servers'} or not isinstance(value['servers'], list) or not 1 <= len(value['servers']) <= 8:
        raise ValueError('MCP ​配置​需要​ 1～8 ​个​ servers')
    names = set()
    for spec in value['servers']:
        if not isinstance(spec, dict) or set(spec)-{'name', 'argv', 'timeout', 'url', 'bearer_env', 'allow_insecure_http', 'oauth','ca_file'}:
            raise ValueError('MCP ​服务​配置​字​段​无效​')
        if 'oauth' in spec:
            from .mcp_oauth import validate_oauth
            validate_oauth(spec)
        name, argv, timeout = spec.get('name'), spec.get('argv'), spec.get('timeout', 30)
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,16}', name) or name in names:
            raise ValueError('MCP ​服务​名称​无效​或​重复​')
        if ('argv' in spec) == ('url' in spec):
            raise ValueError('MCP ​服务​必须​二选​一​配置​ argv ​或​ url')
        if 'url' in spec:
            from .mcp_http import validate_url
            validate_url(spec['url'],spec.get('allow_insecure_http',False))
            if 'ca_file' in spec:
                path=spec['ca_file']
                if not isinstance(path,str) or not Path(path).is_absolute() or not spec['url'].startswith('https://'):
                    raise ValueError('MCP ca_file ​需要​ HTTPS ​服务​和​绝对路径​')
            credential = spec.get('bearer_env')
            if 'bearer_env' in spec and (not isinstance(credential,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}',credential) or credential=='FAST_AGENT_API_KEY'):
                raise ValueError('MCP bearer_env ​必须​是​独立​服务​凭据​的​环境变量​名​')
        else:
            if set(spec)&{'bearer_env','allow_insecure_http','ca_file'}:
                raise ValueError('stdio ​不​接受​ HTTP ​配置​字​段​')
            if not isinstance(argv, list) or not 1 <= len(argv) <= 64 or any(not isinstance(s, str) or not s or len(s)>4000 or '\0' in s for s in argv):
                raise ValueError('MCP argv ​无效​')
        if type(timeout) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(timeout) or not 0 < timeout <= 60:
            raise ValueError('MCP timeout ​必须​在​ 0～60 ​秒​之间​')
        names.add(name)
    return value['servers']


def strip_titles(schema, depth=0):
    """title ​是​ SDK ​生成​的​展示​标注​；​不​删除​任何​验证​约束​。"""
    if depth > 4 or not isinstance(schema, dict):
        raise ValueError('MCP schema ​嵌套​或​类型​无效​')
    title = schema.pop('title', None)
    if title is not None and (not isinstance(title, str) or len(title) > 1000):
        raise ValueError('MCP schema title ​无效​')
    if isinstance(schema.get('properties'), dict):
        for value in schema['properties'].values():
            strip_titles(value, depth+1)
    if 'items' in schema:
        strip_titles(schema['items'], depth+1)


class MCPManager:
    def __init__(self, path, context):
        self.specs = load_servers(path)
        self.context = context
        self.clients = []
        self.oauth_sessions = []
        self.started = False
        self.generation = 0

    def close(self):
        self.generation += 1
        for client in self.clients:
            client.close()
        for session in self.oauth_sessions:
            session.close()

    def start(self):
        if self.started:
            raise ValueError('MCP ​管理器​不能​重复​启动​')
        from .tasks import TaskStore
        if TaskStore(self.context.root).blockers():
            raise ValueError('​存在​未​核实​操作​，​不能​启动​ MCP ​服务​')
        self.started = True
        tools = []
        try:
            for spec in self.specs:
                # ​服务​启动​本身​就是​执行​代码​，​不​复用​命令​白名单​自动​批准​。
                remote = 'url' in spec
                target = {'server':spec['name'], **({'url':spec['url']} if remote else {'argv':spec['argv']})}
                if 'ca_file' in spec:target['ca_file']=spec['ca_file']
                prompt = ('​连接​远程​ MCP（​参数​将​发往​该​服务​；​远端​不受​本机​沙箱​限制​）' if remote else '​启动​ MCP ​服务​ ')
                if not self.context.authorize('mcp_start', target, prompt+json.dumps(target, ensure_ascii=False)+'？'):
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​启动​未获​授权​')
                if remote:
                    from .mcp_http import HttpClient
                    token = os.environ.get(spec['bearer_env'], '') if 'bearer_env' in spec else None
                    provider=None
                    if 'oauth' in spec:
                        from .mcp_oauth import make_session
                        session=make_session(spec,self.context)
                        self.oauth_sessions.append(session)
                        provider=session.access_token
                    from .mcp_tls import tls_context
                    tls=tls_context(spec)
                    client = HttpClient(spec['url'],spec.get('timeout',30),token,spec.get('allow_insecure_http',False),token_provider=provider,tls_context=tls)
                else:
                    argv, env = command_launch(spec['argv'], self.context.root, self.context.sandbox)
                    env = {k:v for k,v in env.items() if k in {'PATH','LANG','LC_ALL','LC_CTYPE','TZ','TERM','HOME','TMPDIR','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'}}
                    client = StdioClient(argv, env, self.context.root, spec.get('timeout',30))
                self.clients.append(client)
                client.initialize()
                tools.extend(self.discover(spec, client, len(tools)))
            return tools
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def status(self):
        return [{'server':spec['name'], 'transport':'http' if 'url' in spec else 'stdio',
                 'connected':i<len(self.clients) and self.clients[i].is_alive}
                for i,spec in enumerate(self.specs)]

    def refresh(self):
        from .tasks import TaskStore
        if self.context.read_only or self.context.blockers or TaskStore(self.context.root).blockers():
            raise ValueError('​当前​模式​或​未​核实​操作​不​允许​刷新​ MCP')
        if not self.clients or not all(row['connected'] for row in self.status()):
            raise ValueError('MCP ​未​全部​连接​，​请​先重​连​')
        if not self.context.authorize('mcp_refresh', {'servers':[s['name'] for s in self.specs]}, '​重新​向​ MCP ​服务​发现​工具​？'):
            raise ValueError('MCP ​刷新​未获​授权​')
        self.generation += 1
        tools=[]
        try:
            for spec,client in zip(self.specs,self.clients):
                tools.extend(self.discover(spec,client,len(tools)))
            return tools
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def discover(self,spec,client,offset=0):
        tools=[]
        cursor = None
        seen = set()
        for _ in range(16):
            reply = client.request('tools/list', {} if cursor is None else {'cursor':cursor})
            entries = reply.get('tools')
            if not isinstance(entries, list):
                raise ValueError('MCP tools/list ​无效​')
            for entry in entries:
                if offset + len(tools) >= 64:
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​工具​总数​超过​ 64')
                tool = self.make_tool(spec, client, entry)
                if any(t.name == tool.name for t in tools):
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​工具​名称​重复​')
                tools.append(tool)
            cursor = reply.get('nextCursor')
            if cursor is None:
                break
            if not isinstance(cursor,str) or len(cursor)>1000 or cursor in seen:
                raise ValueError('MCP ​分页​游标​无效​或​重复​')
            seen.add(cursor)
        else:
            raise ValueError('MCP ​工具​分页​超过​ 16 ​页​')
        return tools

    def make_tool(self, spec, client, entry):
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            raise ValueError('MCP ​工具​声明​无效​')
        name = entry.get('name')
        description = entry.get('description', name)
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}', name):
            raise ValueError('MCP ​工具​名​不​支持​')
        if not isinstance(description,str) or len(description)>1000:
            raise ValueError('MCP ​工具​说明​超过​ 1000 ​字符​')
        schema = copy.deepcopy(entry.get('inputSchema'))
        strip_titles(schema)
        schema_checked(schema)
        if schema['type'] != 'object':
            raise ValueError('MCP ​参数​必须​为​ object')
        public_name = 'mcp_'+spec['name']+'_'+name
        generation = self.generation
        def invoke(args, context):
            if generation != self.generation:
                raise ToolInputError('MCP ​工具​定义​已​失效​，​请​使用​刷新​后​的​工具​')
            try:
                encoded = json.dumps(args, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
            except ValueError:
                raise ToolInputError('MCP ​参数​包含​非​有限​数值​') from None
            if len(encoded.encode()) > 32768:
                raise ToolInputError('MCP ​参数​超过​ 32 KiB')
            if client.closed:
                raise ToolInputError('MCP ​服务​已​关闭​；​核实​之前​结果​后​重新启动​')
            target = {'server':spec['name'], 'tool':name, 'arguments':args}
            if 'url' in spec:
                target['url'] = spec['url']
            if not context.authorize('mcp_call', target, '​调用​ MCP ​工具​ '+json.dumps(target, ensure_ascii=False)+'？'):
                return ToolResult(False, error='MCP ​调用​未获​授权​')
            try:
                reply = client.request('tools/call', {'name':name, 'arguments':args})
                content = reply.get('content')
                if (not isinstance(content,list) or type(reply.get('isError',False)) is not bool
                        or any(not isinstance(c,dict) or c.get('type')!='text' or not isinstance(c.get('text'),str) for c in content)
                        or ('structuredContent' in reply and not isinstance(reply['structuredContent'],dict))):
                    raise ValueError('​当前​仅​支持​ MCP ​文本​和​对象​结构化​结果​')
                data = {'server':spec['name'], 'tool':name, 'content':content}
                if 'structuredContent' in reply:
                    data['structuredContent'] = reply['structuredContent']
                failed = reply.get('isError', False)
                # ​服务​报告​失败​仍​可能​已经​写入​，​不能​当作​可​安全​重试​的​纯​校验​错误​。
                if failed:
                    data['uncertain'] = True
                return ToolResult(not failed, data, 'MCP ​工具​报告​失败​，​请​核实​副作用​' if failed else None)
            except (ValueError, OSError, RecursionError) as exc:
                from .mcp_http import MCPHTTPError
                hint = ('；'+str(exc)) if isinstance(exc,MCPHTTPError) else ''
                client.close()
                return ToolResult(False, {'uncertain':True, 'server':spec['name'], 'tool':name},
                                  'MCP ​调用​结果​不​确定​，​连接​已​关闭​；​请​核实​，​不​自动​重试​'+hint)
        return Tool(public_name, description+'（​外部​ MCP ​服务​，​调用​需要​授权​）', schema, invoke, 'write')

"""​有界​的​ MCP 2025 stdio ​传输​。​同步​客户端​每次​仅​允许​一个​请求​。"""
import json
import os
import selectors
import signal
import subprocess
import time

VERSIONS = {'2025-11-25', '2025-06-18', '2024-11-05'}
MAX_FRAME = 65536


def decode(raw):
    def reject(value):
        raise ValueError('​非​有限​ JSON ​数值​')
    value = json.loads(raw, parse_constant=reject)
    json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False)
    return value


class StdioClient:
    def __init__(self, argv, env, root, timeout):
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.sequence = 0
        self.buffer = b''
        self.closed = False
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                        start_new_session=True, bufsize=0)
        self.selector = selectors.DefaultSelector()
        for stream in (self.process.stdout, self.process.stderr):
            os.set_blocking(stream.fileno(), False)
            self.selector.register(stream, selectors.EVENT_READ)
        os.set_blocking(self.process.stdin.fileno(), False)

    @property
    def is_alive(self):
        return not self.closed and self.process.poll() is None

    def close(self):
        if self.closed:
            return
        self.closed = True
        # ​即便​父​进程​已经​退出​，​也​清理​仍​持有​管道​的​同组​后代​。
        try:
            os.killpg(self.process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
            if self.process.poll() is None:
                self.process.kill()
        try:
            self.process.wait(timeout=.5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            pass
        try:
            os.killpg(self.process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
            if self.process.poll() is None:
                self.process.kill()
        self.process.wait(timeout=2)
        self.selector.close()
        for stream in (self.process.stdin, self.process.stdout, self.process.stderr):
            stream.close()

    def send(self, message, deadline=None):
        raw = (json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
        if len(raw) > MAX_FRAME:
            raise ValueError('MCP ​请求​超过​ 64 KiB')
        deadline = deadline if deadline is not None else time.monotonic()+self.timeout
        with selectors.DefaultSelector() as writable:
            writable.register(self.process.stdin, selectors.EVENT_WRITE)
            while raw:
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​写入​超时​')
                if not writable.select(max(0, deadline-time.monotonic())):
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​写入​超时​')
                count = os.write(self.process.stdin.fileno(), raw)
                raw = raw[count:]

    def request(self, method, params):
        if self.closed:
            raise ValueError('MCP ​连接​已​关闭​，​需​重新​授权​启动​')
        self.sequence += 1
        request_id = self.sequence
        deadline = time.monotonic()+self.timeout
        total = 0
        messages = 0
        try:
            self.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0', 'id':request_id, 'method':method, 'params':params}, deadline)
            while True:
                while b'\n' in self.buffer:
                    line, self.buffer = self.buffer.split(b'\n', 1)
                    messages += 1
                    if len(line) > MAX_FRAME or messages > 100 or time.monotonic() > deadline:
                        raise ValueError('MCP ​消息​超限​或​超时​')
                    message = decode(line)
                    if not isinstance(message, dict) or message.get('jsonrpc') != '2.0':
                        raise ValueError('MCP JSON-RPC ​响应​无效​')
                    if 'method' in message:
                        if 'id' in message:
                            self.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0', 'id':message['id'], 'error':{'code':-32601, 'message':'Client capability not supported'}}, deadline)
                        # ​通知​是非​可信​数据​，​不​执行​服务端​指令​。
                        continue
                    if type(message.get('id')) is not int or message['id'] != request_id:
                        raise ValueError('MCP ​响应​ id ​不​匹配​')
                    if ('result' in message) == ('error' in message):
                        raise ValueError('MCP ​响应​格式​无效​')
                    if 'error' in message:
                        raise ValueError('MCP ​服务​返回​协议​错误​')
                    if not isinstance(message['result'], dict):
                        raise ValueError('MCP result ​必须​为​对象​')
                    return message['result']
                if len(self.buffer) > MAX_FRAME:
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​帧​超过​ 64 KiB')
                remaining = deadline-time.monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​请求​超时​')
                ready = self.selector.select(remaining)
                if not ready:
                    raise ValueError('MCP ​请求​超时​')
                for key, _ in ready:
                    chunk = os.read(key.fd, 8192)
                    if not chunk:
                        self.selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
                        if key.fileobj is self.process.stdout:
                            raise ValueError('MCP ​服务​断开​')
                        continue
                    total += len(chunk)
                    if total > 1048576:
                        raise ValueError('MCP ​响应​流​超过​ 1 MiB')
                    if key.fileobj is self.process.stdout:
                        self.buffer += chunk
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def initialize(self):
        result = self.request('initialize', {'protocolVersion':'2025-11-25', 'capabilities':{},
            'clientInfo':{'name':'fast-agent', 'version':'0.1.0'}})
        if (not isinstance(result.get('protocolVersion'), str) or result['protocolVersion'] not in VERSIONS
                or not isinstance(result.get('capabilities'), dict)
                or not isinstance(result['capabilities'].get('tools'), dict)):
            raise ValueError('MCP ​协议​版本​或​ tools ​能力​不​支持​')
        self.send({'jsonrpc':'2.0', 'method':'notifications/initialized'})

"""​短​生命周期​回环​回调​，​不​记录​ URL/​授权​码​，​不​打开​浏览器​。"""
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import time
from .oauth_flow import begin


class Callback:
    def __init__(self,port=0):
        if type(port) is not int or not 0<=port<=65535:raise ValueError('​回调​端口​无效​')
        owner=self
        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self,*args):pass
            def do_GET(self):
                if owner.pending is None or self.headers.get_all('Host') != [f'127.0.0.1:{owner.port}'] or not self.path.startswith('/callback?') or len(self.path)>8192:
                    self.reply(400);return
                try:owner.form=owner.pending.accept(owner.redirect_uri+self.path[len('/callback'):])
                except ValueError:
                    if owner.pending.consumed:owner.failed=True
                    self.reply(400);return
                self.reply(200)
            def reply(self,status):
                body=('​授权​回调​已​接收​，​可​返回​终端​。' if status==200 else '​授权​回调​无效​。').encode()
                self.send_response(status)
                self.send_header('Content-Type','text/plain; charset=utf-8')
                self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)))
                self.send_header('Cache-Control','no-store')
                self.send_header('Referrer-Policy','no-referrer')
                self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
        self.pending=None;self.form=None;self.failed=False
        class Server(HTTPServer):
            def get_request(self):
                connection,address=super().get_request()
                connection.settimeout(1)
                return connection,address
            def handle_error(self,*args):pass
        self.server=Server(('127.0.0.1',port),Handler)
        self.server.timeout=0.25
        self.port=self.server.server_address[1]
        self.redirect_uri=f'http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/callback'

    def start(self,resource,metadata,issuer,client_id,scope=''):
        if self.pending is not None:raise ValueError('​回调​事务​已​启动​')
        self.pending,url=begin(resource,metadata,issuer,client_id,self.redirect_uri,scope)
        return url

    def wait(self,timeout=300):
        if self.pending is None:raise ValueError('​回调​事务​尚未​启动​')
        if type(timeout) not in (int,float) or not 0<timeout<=300:raise ValueError('​回调​等待​需为​0～300​秒​')
        deadline=min(time.monotonic()+timeout,self.pending.expires)
        try:
            while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                self.server.handle_request()
                if self.form is not None:return self.form
                if self.failed:raise ValueError('​用户​取消​或​授权​回调​失败​')
            raise ValueError('​等待​授权​回调​超时​')
        finally:self.close()

    def close(self):self.server.server_close()
    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()

"""​有​界​、​无​凭据​ OAuth ​元​数据​发现​；​跨​来源​访问​先获​显式​许可​。"""
import json
import re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import httpx2
from .oauth_flow import secure_endpoint,validate_metadata


class DiscoveryError(ValueError):pass


def origin(url):
    parts=urlsplit(secure_endpoint(url))
    return parts.scheme,parts.hostname,parts.port or 443


def resource_metadata_urls(resource):
    parts=urlsplit(secure_endpoint(resource));base=f'{parts.scheme}://{parts.netloc}'
    paths=[base+'/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource'+parts.path.rstrip('/')]
    root=base+'/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource'
    if root not in paths:paths.append(root)
    return paths


def issuer_metadata_urls(issuer):
    parts=urlsplit(secure_endpoint(issuer));base=f'{parts.scheme}://{parts.netloc}';path=parts.path.rstrip('/')
    urls=[base+'/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'+path,base+'/.well-known/openid-configuration'+path]
    if path:urls.append(issuer.rstrip('/')+'/.well-known/openid-configuration')
    return urls


def challenge_metadata(header):
    if not header:return None
    if not isinstance(header,str) or len(header)>8192:raise DiscoveryError('​认证​ challenge ​超限​')
    # ​定位​ Bearer ​段​，​拒绝​重复​ resource_metadata，​避免​不同​挑战​混淆​。
    match=re.search(r'(?:^|,)\s*Bearer\s+',header,re.I)
    if not match:return None
    segment=header[match.end():]
    boundary=re.search(r',\s*[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\s+(?![=])',segment)
    if boundary:segment=segment[:boundary.start()]
    values=re.findall(r'(?:^|,)\s*resource_metadata\s*=\s*"([^"\\]*)"\s*(?=,|$)',segment,re.I)
    if len(values)>1:raise DiscoveryError('​资源​元​数据​挑战​重复​')
    if re.search(r'\bresource_metadata\s*=',segment,re.I) and not values:raise DiscoveryError('​资源​元​数据​挑战​格式​无效​')
    return secure_endpoint(values[0]) if values else None


class Discovery:
    def __init__(self,approve,*,transport=None,tls_context=True):
        self.approve=approve
        self.http=httpx2.Client(timeout=10,follow_redirects=False,trust_env=True,transport=transport,verify=tls_context)
        self.approved=set()

    def close(self):self.http.close()

    def allow(self,url,resource):
        host=origin(url)
        if host!=origin(resource) and host not in self.approved:
            if not self.approve(url):raise DiscoveryError('​未​批准​访问​授权​服务​来源​')
            self.approved.add(host)

    def fetch(self,url,resource):
        self.allow(url,resource)
        try:
            # ​新建​的​专用​客户端​没有​认证​头​；​不​保留​服务​设置​的​ cookie。
            self.http.cookies.clear()
            with self.http.stream('GET',url,headers={'Accept':'application/json'}) as response:
                if response.status_code==404:return None
                if response.status_code!=200:raise DiscoveryError('OAuth ​元​数据​请求​失败​或​重定向​被​拒绝​')
                if response.headers.get('content-type','').split(';')[0].strip() not in {'application/json'}:
                    raise DiscoveryError('OAuth ​元​数据​不是​ JSON')
                data=bytearray()
                for chunk in response.iter_bytes():
                    data.extend(chunk)
                    if len(data)>65536:raise DiscoveryError('OAuth ​元​数据​超过​ 64 KiB')
                value=json.loads(data)
                if not isinstance(value,dict):raise DiscoveryError('OAuth ​元​数据​必须​是​对象​')
                return value
        except DiscoveryError:raise
        except Exception:raise DiscoveryError('OAuth ​元​数据​读取​失败​') from None
        finally:self.http.cookies.clear()

    def discover(self,resource,*,challenge=None,issuer=None):
        secure_endpoint(resource)
        challenge_url=challenge_metadata(challenge)
        candidates=[challenge_url] if challenge_url else resource_metadata_urls(resource)
        protected=None
        for url in candidates:
            protected=self.fetch(url,resource)
            if protected is not None:break
        if protected is None or protected.get('resource')!=resource:raise DiscoveryError('​资源​元​数据​缺失​或​资源​不​匹配​')
        issuers=protected.get('authorization_servers')
        if not isinstance(issuers,list) or not 1<=len(issuers)<=10 or any(not isinstance(i,str) for i in issuers):
            raise DiscoveryError('​授权​服务​列表​无效​')
        for item in issuers:secure_endpoint(item)
        if issuer is None:
            if len(issuers)!=1:raise DiscoveryError('​多个​授权​服务​，​请​显式​选择​ issuer')
            issuer=issuers[0]
        if issuer not in issuers:raise DiscoveryError('​选择​的​ issuer ​不​属于​此​资源​')
        metadata=None
        for url in issuer_metadata_urls(issuer):
            metadata=self.fetch(url,resource)
            if metadata is not None:break
        checked=validate_metadata(metadata,issuer)
        for key in ('authorization_endpoint','token_endpoint'):
            self.allow(checked[key],resource)
        return {'resource':resource,'issuer':issuer,'metadata':metadata}

"""OAuth ​授权​码​事务​：PKCE S256、​资源​绑定​和​一次性​回调​。​无​网络​副作用​。"""
import base64
from dataclasses import dataclass,field
import hashlib
import secrets
import time
from urllib.parse import urlencode,urlsplit,parse_qs
from .mcp_http import validate_url


def secure_endpoint(url):
    parts=validate_url(url)
    if parts.scheme!='https':raise ValueError('OAuth ​端点​必须​使用​ HTTPS')
    return url


def validate_metadata(metadata,issuer):
    secure_endpoint(issuer)
    if not isinstance(metadata,dict) or metadata.get('issuer')!=issuer:
        raise ValueError('OAuth issuer ​不​匹配​')
    for key in ('authorization_endpoint','token_endpoint'):
        secure_endpoint(metadata.get(key))
    for key in ('code_challenge_methods_supported','response_types_supported','token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported'):
        if not isinstance(metadata.get(key),list) or any(not isinstance(v,str) for v in metadata[key]):
            raise ValueError('OAuth ​能力​元​数据格式​无效​')
    if 'S256' not in metadata.get('code_challenge_methods_supported',[]):
        raise ValueError('​授权​服务​未声明​ PKCE S256 ​支持​')
    if 'code' not in metadata.get('response_types_supported',[]):
        raise ValueError('​授权​服务​不​支持​授权​码​响应​')
    if 'none' not in metadata.get('token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported',[]):
        raise ValueError('​当前​仅​支持​预​注册​公共​客户端​')
    return {key:metadata[key] for key in ('issuer','authorization_endpoint','token_endpoint')}


@dataclass(repr=False)
class Authorization:
    resource:str
    client_id:str
    redirect_uri:str
    token_endpoint:str
    scope:str
    verifier:str=field(repr=False)
    state:str=field(repr=False)
    expires:float
    consumed:bool=False

    def accept(self,callback):
        if self.consumed or time.monotonic()>self.expires:raise ValueError('​授权​事务​已​使用​或​已过期​')
        if not isinstance(callback,str) or len(callback)>8192 or any(ord(c)<=32 for c in callback):raise ValueError('​授权​回调​无效​')
        parts=urlsplit(callback);expected=urlsplit(self.redirect_uri)
        if parts.fragment or (parts.scheme,parts.netloc,parts.path)!=(expected.scheme,expected.netloc,expected.path):
            raise ValueError('​授权​回调​地址​不​匹配​')
        query=parse_qs(parts.query,keep_blank_values=True,strict_parsing=True,max_num_fields=10)
        state=query.get('state',[])
        if len(state)!=1 or not secrets.compare_digest(state[0].encode(),self.state.encode()):raise ValueError('​授权​ state ​不​匹配​')
        self.consumed=True
        if 'error' in query:raise ValueError('​授权​服务​拒绝​或​用户​取消​授权​')
        codes=query.get('code',[])
        if len(codes)!=1 or not codes[0] or len(codes[0])>4096:raise ValueError('​授权​码​无效​')
        return {'grant_type':'authorization_code','client_id':self.client_id,'code':codes[0],
                'code_verifier':self.verifier,'redirect_uri':self.redirect_uri,'resource':self.resource}


def begin(resource,metadata,issuer,client_id,redirect_uri,scope=''):
    secure_endpoint(resource)
    endpoints=validate_metadata(metadata,issuer)
    redirect=validate_url(redirect_uri)
    if redirect.scheme!='http' or redirect.hostname!='127.0.0.1' or not redirect.port:
        raise ValueError('​回调​必须​是​带​显式​端口​的​ 127.0.0.1 HTTP ​地址​')
    if not isinstance(client_id,str) or not 1<=len(client_id)<=1024 or any(ord(c)<33 for c in client_id):
        raise ValueError('​客户端​ ID ​无效​')
    if not isinstance(scope,str) or len(scope)>2000 or any(ord(c)<32 or ord(c)>126 for c in scope):
        raise ValueError('OAuth scope ​无效​')
    verifier=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);state=secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    challenge=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
    pending=Authorization(resource,client_id,redirect_uri,endpoints['token_endpoint'],scope,verifier,state,time.monotonic()+300)
    parameters={'response_type':'code','client_id':client_id,'redirect_uri':redirect_uri,
                'resource':resource,'state':state,'code_challenge':challenge,'code_challenge_method':'S256'}
    if scope:parameters['scope']=scope
    return pending,endpoints['authorization_endpoint']+'?'+urlencode(parameters)

"""​授权​控制​层​：​工作​区外​仓储​、​明确​批准​、​刷新​前​失效​和​本地​登出​。"""
from pathlib import Path
import time
from .oauth_callback import Callback
from .oauth_discovery import Discovery
from .oauth_store import CredentialStore
from .oauth_tokens import TokenClient,parse_tokens


class OAuthSession:
    def __init__(self,workspace,directory,resource,client_id,approve,*,issuer=None,scope='',port=0,transport=None,tls_context=True):
        workspace=Path(workspace).resolve();directory=Path(directory).absolute()
        if directory.resolve().is_relative_to(workspace):raise ValueError('OAuth ​凭据​目录​必须​位于​工作​区外​')
        self.store=CredentialStore(directory)
        self.resource,self.client_id,self.issuer=resource,client_id,issuer
        self.scope,self.port,self.approve=scope,port,approve
        self.discovery=Discovery(approve,transport=transport,tls_context=tls_context)
        self.client=TokenClient(transport=transport,tls_context=tls_context)
        self.metadata=None

    def discover(self):
        result=self.discovery.discover(self.resource,issuer=self.issuer)
        self.issuer=result['issuer'];self.metadata=result['metadata']

    def identity(self):
        if self.metadata is None:self.discover()
        return self.resource,self.issuer,self.client_id

    def login(self,show_url):
        identity=self.identity()
        if not self.approve(self.metadata['authorization_endpoint']):raise ValueError('​未​批准​开始​授权​')
        with self.store.lock(*identity),Callback(self.port) as callback:
            url=callback.start(self.resource,self.metadata,self.issuer,self.client_id,self.scope)
            show_url(url)
            form=callback.wait()
            value=self.client.post(callback.pending.token_endpoint,form)
            tokens=parse_tokens(value,resource=self.resource,issuer=self.issuer,client_id=self.client_id,scope=self.scope)
            self.store.save(tokens)
            return tokens.status()

    def access_token(self):
        identity=self.identity()
        with self.store.lock(*identity):
            tokens=self.store.load(*identity)
            if tokens is None:raise ValueError('​尚未​授权​，​请​先​登录​')
            if tokens.expires_at>time.time()+30:return tokens.access_token
            if not self.approve(self.metadata['token_endpoint']):raise ValueError('​未​批准​刷新​凭据​')
            # ​先使​旧​刷新​凭据​不可​再​使用​；​网络​或​落盘​失败​需要​重新​登录​。
            self.store.delete(*identity)
            updated=self.client.refresh(tokens,self.metadata['token_endpoint'])
            self.store.save(updated)
            return updated.access_token

    def logout(self,*,revoke=False):
        identity=(self.resource,self.issuer,self.client_id) if self.issuer else self.identity()
        if not self.approve(self.resource):raise ValueError('​未​批准​登出​')
        with self.store.lock(*identity):
            tokens=self.store.load(*identity)
            self.store.delete(*identity)
            if revoke and tokens:
                if self.metadata is None:self.discover()
                endpoint=self.metadata.get('revocation_endpoint')
                if not endpoint:raise ValueError('​本地​凭据​已​移除​；​服务​未声明​撤销​端点​')
                self.discovery.allow(endpoint,self.resource)
                self.client.revoke(tokens,endpoint)
            return {'local_deleted':True,'remote_revoked':bool(revoke and tokens)}

    def close(self):
        self.discovery.close();self.client.close()
